proposedTemplateFields.eclipseMechanics: Lunar eclipses are portals into your soul. When they come around, they can help you uncover the truth and allow you to gain knowledge that will steer your life, changing your path to a better one.
proposedTemplateFields.eclipseNoRitual: Eclipses happen along the Lunar Nodes, and part of the work is letting the situation unfold before deciding what it's supposed to become.

proposedTemplateFields.eclipseAdvice: Release your need to be in control, and allow yourself to flow with the current of whatever is unfolding. Reflect on what you've experienced, and respond accordingly.
proposedTemplateFields.eclipseEndingsNoRitual: Eclipses happen along the Lunar Nodes, and change comes all the same, no matter how tightly you hold on.
proposedTemplateFields.eclipseEndingsAdvice: Release your need to be in control, allow for endings, mourn if needed, and allow yourself to flow with the current of whatever is unfolding, even if the destination is still unknown.
